summary: 38 features and 2 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • application: expose MonoSpecs reload endpoint and invalidate snapshot (6ecf03d)
  • claudehelper: add MonoSpecs reload and safe config cache (6bcdb66)
  • web: publish GPT 6.1 Sol and add Junie to secondary catalog (b6a13e7)
  • http-api: gate git endpoints on monitoring policy (2a9f077)
  • application: surface git auto-refresh and topology in aggregation (6bdfcfd)
  • orleans: implement monitoring policy and gate automatic git work (2ff2785)
  • application: add project git monitoring policy contract (03b7090)
  • web: register Junie provider option and drop credential defaults (194e22c)
  • application: strip Junie credentials from hero configuration (7bf78c5)
  • claudehelper: harden Junie provider settings and credentials (4f76684)
  • web: add Junie primary and secondary profession presets (97a8a26)
  • application: register Junie provider across hero app services (53e7f54)
  • orleans: add Junie grain and executor stream adapter (19f92dd)
  • claudehelper: add Junie CLI provider and configuration wiring (4d809bd)
  • models: add JunieCli provider type and platform identifier (802fe19)
  • application: register quickAICommit confirm-dialog action (3eb2d65)
  • orleans: support proposal-wide global prompt in annotations (3a5dc09)
  • application: surface configured repository tags in aggregation (e0223fa)

HagiCode-org/web

  • ui: add shared action-emphasis utility and finite emphasis tokens (b0cd993)
  • repository: wire MonoSpecs reload into repository refresh controls (3b6b39e)
  • data: add request-guarded repository refresh with MonoSpecs reload (00344b1)
  • monospecs: add reload endpoint, service, and management tab UI (7acc63e)
  • git: surface git auto-refresh in repository panels and status (92fc962)
  • settings: add git auto-refresh preference state and sync (5d1f0c2)
  • hero: refine Junie CLI provider configuration and sanitize secrets (5bc508d)
  • git: add Quick AI Commit exclusions (8931acf)
  • hero: add Junie AI provider support (3029d4f)
  • kanban: use standard opt-out button for quick AI commit reminder (a809786)
  • preset-task: supply remote inserted prompt value before submit (abcf315)
  • ui: pass immediate remote insertion result to voice commands (2e4b41d)
  • kanban: confirm before Quick AI commit from quick actions (ed79057)
  • config: surface quick AI commit in confirm dialog settings (5274f95)
  • confirm-dialog: add quickAICommit action to settings slice (c87f71c)
  • confirm-dialog: manage focus and trap within ConfirmDialog (47dbb4e)
  • proposal: reconcile proposal file list and submit global annotation prompt (5db5144)
  • repository: support tag filtering in repository search and selector (b283b49)
  • favicon: tint favicon by active session count (bfce271)
  • mermaid: add browser-local diagram appearance preset (8ef5beb)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/web

  • project-list: keep StatusPopover open while confirm dialog is shown (5acb1b7)
  • git: close project detail drawer on single-target quick AI commit (fc531b8)
